author: Kevin Stratvert
description: Here’s how to permanently delete your Instagram account. Open Instagram and tap your profile picture in the bottom right. Then tap the three lines in the top right. Tap Accounts Center, then Manage accounts. Select your account, then Deactivation or deletion. Select Delete account, then follow the prompts to permanently delete your account.
title: How to Delete Instagram Account Permanently
